Sunday No-Drop Ride (ABRT Cycling)

Annapolis, MD · Downtown

No-drop

Sunday No-Drop Ride (ABRT Cycling) is a road group ride in Annapolis, MD. It meets Sundays; 8:00 am summer, 9:00 am spring/fall, 10:00 am winter, starting at Prince George St at USNA Barry Gate. Expect about 35–45 miles, 16–18 mph average.

About the Sunday No-Drop Ride (ABRT Cycling) group ride

A team-hosted no-drop road ride from downtown Annapolis with many regroup points. Thirty-five to forty-five miles at 16 to 18 mph. Start time moves with the season. The team's Saturday ride from Davidsonville is faster and only the B group waits.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
